title: DM Test: GJR-GARCH Statistically Significantly Outperforms GARCH
description: Diebold-Mariano test confirms GJR-GARCH is significantly better than GARCH (p<0.001) for SPY QLIKE forecasting. However, GARCH has better VaR coverage.

details.conclusion: GJR best for accuracy, GARCH best for risk management
